title: cultureQC Visit Summary
description: One summarized flask visit (cultureQC_upgrade.md §5.1) — one or more FOV images reduced to numbers, stored in culture/history.py's append-only lineage log (which adds its own record_id/prev_record_hash/record_hash chain fields at write time, per culture/records.py's convention — not part of this schema, which validates the content payload before chaining). Numbers only: no free text, no VLM output.

lineage_id.description: The flask's continuous lineage across passages — the hash-chaining boundary in culture/history.py

segment_id.description: One growth segment within a lineage (between passage events)

timestamp.description: UTC. When the FOV(s) were captured, not when this summary was computed.

image_sha256.description: One SHA-256 per FOV, in the same order as fov_confluency

fov_confluency.description: Confluency percentage per FOV, same order/length as image_sha256

confluency_sd.description: Across this visit's FOVs — not the same thing as configs/noise.yaml's FOV-noise floor (that's the expected repositioning SD; this is what was actually observed this visit)

class_probs.description: Per-class probability, keyed by class name. Raw softmax output until Slice 4b's calibration lands — see 'calibrated'.

class_pred.description: argmax(class_probs), or null if class_probs is null

calibrated.description: False until Slice 4b's temperature scaling (or equivalent) is applied to class_probs. Required so a consumer never mistakes raw softmax confidence for a calibrated one.

anomaly_score.description: Null until Slice 4 (density-conditioned open-set anomaly scoring) is implemented

anomaly_score_density_bin.description: Which confluency-density bin anomaly_score was computed against. Null until Slice 4.

quality.description: culture/quality.py's gate output — see §5.2. A failing visit gets pass:false, reasons populated, and does NOT enter trend computations (culture/history.py enforces this, not this schema).

uniformity.description: Illumination uniformity metric; lower = more uniform

reasons.description: Empty if pass=true. One entry per failed check if pass=false, e.g. 'blur_below_threshold'.

model_versions.description: Every model that produced a number in this visit: name + weights SHA-256 (culture/model_versions.py). culture/history.py's trend functions refuse to mix visits whose model_versions differ (MODEL_VERSION_CHANGE) — see §5.3.

weights_sha256.description: Null only if the model's weights file isn't resolvable on this machine right now (see culture/model_versions.py's 'note' field, not part of this schema) — never a fabricated hash.

config_hashes.description: SHA-256 of every configs/*.yaml file that influenced this visit's numbers (e.g. configs/quality.yaml's thresholds, configs/noise.yaml if used) — keyed by filename.
